debit.notes: The bank publishes no dedicated card-block/hotlist page, no SMS block format and no overseas/NRI number, so call the published lines. Help Desk page lists Toll free 18005998866 with no hours stated; Customer Support lines +040 24685660 and +040 23443812 are answered only 8 am to 8 pm on working days. Email: helpdesk@tgcab.bank.in ('Drop a Mail' on the Help Desk page); info@tgcab.bank.in is also published site-wide in the footer. App: the official TGCAB Mobile Banking page and the site-wide 'Get our App' footer link the Android app com.infrasofttech.tsc and iOS app tscab (id1415635104); the page's published in-app service list includes 'Debit Card Controls' and 'Green Pin generation' alongside NEFT/IMPS/UPI. Website: the Internet Banking login portal https://netbanking.tgcab.bank.in, linked site-wide from the bank's Internet Banking page; that page's published feature list is only 'Balance enquiry', 'Account Statement', 'Loan Statement', 'Fixed Deposit Details' and 'Loan Certificate' - no card-block option among them, so no web card-block path is published. The bank issues only RuPay debit cards (RuPay ATM cum Debit Card and RuPay Platinum Card, per ATM Services).

credit.notes: The bank's official site publishes no credit-card product and no credit-card blocking channel: ATM Services states 'Apex Bank offers Rupay ATM cum Debit card and Rupay Platinum Card to its customers' (both debit cards), and every 'credit' reference on the fetched pages is a loan/merchant credit facility, not a card. The old entry's credit blocking methods (1800-100-4755, 040-23268725, info@tsabbank.com, tsabbank.com netbanking, app links com.tsab.app / id1526327863) could not be verified on any live official page - the tsabbank.com domain no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN, no Wayback snapshots) - and are dropped. The bank-wide contacts published under 'debit' are the only emergency lines available to any cardholder.

upi.notes: The bank's official pages publish no self-service UPI freeze: the dedicated UPI Services page proves UPI runs through the TGCAB App ('UPI Payments: Send and receive money instantly using your UPI ID, mobile number, or QR code', plus Scan & Pay and Pay to UPI ID / Mobile Number), and the app's 'Services Offered' list includes the 'UPI' tile alongside NEFT/IMPS, but no in-app UPI lock/freeze/deregister menu path is published - the in-app 'Debit Card Controls' tile covers cards only, so hotlisting the RuPay debit card does not freeze UPI. The only published stop mechanism is for AutoPay mandates: 'Customers can create, view, modify, pause/resume, or cancel eligible UPI mandates through the Bank's supported UPI/mobile banking channels, subject to applicable terms and conditions' - pausing/cancelling stops recurring UPI debits only, not all UPI access. Emergency fallback is the bank-wide Help Desk: 'Toll free 18005998866' (no UPI-specific helpline published), Customer Support '+(040) 24685660 (8 am to 8pm - on working days only)' and '+(040) 23443812', or 'Drop a Mail: helpdesk@tgcab.bank.in'. No netbanking UPI manage/disable path (Internet Banking feature list: 'Balance enquiry', 'Account Statement', 'Loan Statement', 'Fixed Deposit Details', 'Loan Certificate'), no UPI SMS keyword and no *99#/USSD channel appear on any fetched official page.
